title: BNPL Gold: Late Fees, Minimum Payments, and Avoiding Penalties
summary: This document explains BNPL Gold late fees, minimum payment expectations, and how to avoid penalties. It covers late-fee charging if the minimum isn’t received by the due date, minimum/auto-debit collection attempts, scheduled auto-debit day, and guidance to verify funds and make manual/partial payments.
